scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check src tests
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:py
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:js && npm run format:check:py
scripts.format:py: uv run ruff format src tests
scripts.format:check:py: uv run ruff format --check src tests
